nphi.title: CARPHA–Georgetown CGHPI MoU on health systems and implementation science
nphi.with: Georgetown University Center for Global Health Practice and Impact (CGHPI)
nphi.summary: MoU of March 2026 for joint health systems and implementation research, workforce development and technical assistance on integrated communicable and NCD care for CARPHA member states.

nphi.title: Caribbean Antimicrobial Resistance Alliance (CARA)
nphi.with: Caribbean Public Health Agency (CARPHA); CARPHA reference laboratories in Trinidad and Tobago, Jamaica and Saint Lucia; PAHO (parallel project)
nphi.summary: A Fleming Fund-supported partnership between UKHSA and CARPHA that expands AMR reference laboratory services and builds a region-wide digital AMR surveillance platform. It was formally launched in Barbados in May 2025.

nphi.title: CDC Caribbean and Central America Regional Office (CCAMRO)
nphi.with: Caribbean Public Health Agency (CARPHA) and its Reference Laboratory; Council of Ministers of Health of Central America (COMISCA); Gorgas Memorial Institute; SENACYT; INDICASAT
nphi.summary: Launched in 2024 in Panama City, CDC's CCAMRO covers 21 countries, working with CARPHA, COMISCA and Panama's Gorgas Memorial Institute on early warning, surveillance, laboratory strengthening and emergency response capacity.

nphi.title: CARPHA – UKHSA memorandum of understanding
nphi.summary: MoU for an equal partnership on outbreak response, lab and workforce capacity, genomic surveillance, AMR, NCDs and healthy tourism, preceded by UKHSA secondments in surveillance and field epidemiology in 2023.

nphi.title: Pandemic Fund Caribbean project: integrated early warning, surveillance and laboratory systems
nphi.with: Inter-American Development Bank (implementing entity); also Antigua and Barbuda, Dominica, Grenada, St Kitts and Nevis, St Lucia, St Vincent and the Grenadines
nphi.summary: US$16 million Pandemic Fund grant led regionally by CARPHA for 12 member states, covering regional coordination, surveillance, laboratory systems, workforce development and emergency management.

nphi.title: CARPHA–HISP Centre (University of Oslo) MoU on DHIS2-based surveillance
nphi.summary: Five-year MoU (2023–2028) to strengthen Caribbean public health and disease surveillance systems using DHIS2, through training, joint research and connection to the global DHIS2 community.

nphi.title: COVIGEN/RESVIGEN – Regional Genomic Surveillance Network for respiratory viruses
nphi.with: Regional sequencing labs: Fiocruz; ISP Chile; INS Colombia; Inciensa; InDRE; Gorgas; University of the West Indies; US CDC
nphi.summary: PAHO network created in 2020 with eight regional sequencing laboratories, mostly national public health institutes, supporting countries to adopt routine genomic surveillance of SARS-CoV-2, influenza and RSV.

nphi.title: PulseNet Latin America and the Caribbean (PNALC)
nphi.actor: ANLIS Dr. Carlos G. Malbrán – INEI Bacteriology (regional coordinator)
nphi.with: PAHO; US CDC PulseNet International; CARPHA (for its member states); national public health laboratories
nphi.summary: Molecular subtyping network for foodborne disease surveillance founded in 2004, regionally coordinated by INEI-ANLIS Malbrán with PAHO, linking national laboratories of 16 countries plus CARPHA within PulseNet International.

nphi.title: CDC Caribbean Regional Office
nphi.with: Caribbean ministries of health; Caribbean Public Health Agency (CARPHA); Caribbean FETP
nphi.summary: CDC established its Caribbean Regional Office in Trinidad and Tobago in 2002 (moved to Jamaica in 2018), supporting ministries of health on HIV/TB, lab accreditation, health information systems, emergency management and a regional FETP…

nphi.title: New Variant Assessment Platform (NVAP) – international genomic surveillance partnerships
nphi.with: National partners in nine countries/territories; WHO EMRO sequencing hubs (Oman, Abu Dhabi, Morocco); Africa CDC; CARPHA
nphi.summary: Set up by PHE in 2021 and continued by UKHSA, NVAP provides sequencing reagents, training in bioinformatics and variant risk assessment, and scientific exchanges to partner countries and regional bodies.

nphi.title: PHAC–CARPHA collaboration on COVID-19 critical care capacity (F-ACES course)
nphi.with: Caribbean Public Health Agency (CARPHA) and its Member States; Royal College of Physicians and Surgeons of Canada
nphi.summary: PHAC worked with CARPHA to strengthen Member States' COVID-19 response capacity through the Facilitated Acute Critical Events Simulation course, framed as strengthening regional health security.

nphi.title: CARPHA–JICA project on regional health security for outbreak prevention and control
nphi.summary: Technical cooperation project of about US$1 million signed in November 2021 to strengthen CARPHA's laboratory core capacity, including genome sequencing supplies, equipment, a laboratory information system and staff training.

nphi.title: Belmont Forum: Community collective action on climate change and the environment–health nexus
nphi.with: University College London; RAND Corporation; University of the West Indies; University of Oslo
nphi.summary: Comparative study of how volunteer community groups in Alaska and Trinidad and Tobago organise to respond to climate-related health impacts, aimed at informing health-system resilience planning.

nphi.title: IANPHI Latin America Network COVID-19 exchanges
nphi.with: ANLIS (Argentina); INLASA (Bolivia); CARPHA; INS Colombia; INCIENSA (Costa Rica); INSP Mexico; INS Peru; Guyana CMO; Uruguay MoH
nphi.summary: The Fiocruz-chaired Latin American NPHI network held bi-weekly virtual meetings in 2020 to share COVID-19 responses, serology, lab quality control and kit production.

nphi.title: Argentina–PAHO–CARICOM triangular project on AMR detection and surveillance
nphi.actor: ANLIS Dr. Carlos G. Malbrán – INEI
nphi.with: CARICOM Secretariat; PAHO/WHO; SENASA; Argentine Fund for International Cooperation (FO.AR); Best-dos Santos Public Health Laboratory (Barbados) and other CARICOM national laboratories
nphi.summary: Two-year FO.AR-funded triangular cooperation (2019–2021) in which Malbrán's INEI hosted internships and trained Caribbean laboratory technologists to strengthen clinical AMR diagnosis and surveillance in 14 CARICOM countries.

nphi.title: Enhanced biological security and disease surveillance in the Caribbean (modular laboratory for CAREC)
nphi.with: Caribbean Epidemiology Centre (CAREC, now part of CARPHA)
nphi.summary: Canada's Global Partnership Program gave CAD 2.5 million (2012–2013) for a fully equipped modular laboratory at CAREC in Port of Spain, to improve rapid detection and response to natural or deliberate outbreaks in the Caribbean.

indicators.label: E. coli bloodstream infections resistant to 3rd-generation cephalosporins
